overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board's official posting location is the Town website, and the January 11 notice was posted there more than 48 hours ahead, though not on the Board's own subpage.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board did not post notice for its January 11 meeting, because the notice appeared on the Town homepage calendar but not on the Board's own webpage.
allegations.key_passage: Since the Board’s official posting location is the Town website and the notice was in fact posted there, in an intuitive location that is regularly used, more than 48 hours in advance of the meeting, we find no violation with respect to the posting of the notice for the January 11 meeting.
